notes.title: New Project Reveal: Crimson System — VɅΔ Protocol
notes.content:
[h1]Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol — First Look[/h1][p]
[b]AN AI‑REIMAGINED RETRO FPS[/b]  
You wake in glowing stasis capsules. Footsteps echo in the dark. Somewhere on this station, [i]something is hungry[/i].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10584768/a9043eb2d2e538a46002b607b8203e8c0a42eb33.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi, I'm Slamert, a solo developer.   I've always wanted to build a classic shooter, but the scope felt impossible — until AI tools arrived. So I began an experiment: [i]one human + neural networks[/i].[/p][list][*][p]Every sprite, texture, model and sound was born in a dialogue with AI, then hand‑polished in Godot Engine[/p][/*][*][p]No premade assets — just carbon and silicon neurons working together[/p][/*][*][p]The result is a fast, dark, 90s‑flavoured FPS with 2D sprites in full 3D levels  [/p][/*][/list][h2]Why this matters[/h2][p]If you miss straightforward old‑school shooters — or you’re curious where this experiment leads — please add the game to your wishlist. It helps a ton![/p][p]ːsuperstarː [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876620/Crimson_System_VD_Protocol/" style="button" buttoncolor="#6ea820"]Add Crimson System to your Wishlist[/url][/p]
